scientific_notes: Educational redraw based on Self Forcing arXiv:2506.08009v2, Sections 3.1–3.4, Algorithms 1–2 and appendices. https://arxiv.org/html/2506.08009v2 . Official implementation: https://github.com/guandeh17/Self-Forcing . This is an independent illustration, not an official figure.

Scope: text-to-video, chunk-wise Self Forcing with DMD. Shared G samples successive latent chunks conditioned on text and self-generated clean history. A separate G pass at t=0 writes clean KV after each chunk. Cached history reads are detached during training.

Panel b expands one denoising call. Flow prediction yields a clean estimate, which is re-noised at a lower timestep within the same chunk. During training only the last executed call of each chunk receives gradient. The stop-at-step-2 schedule is illustrative; inference uses all four calls.

The generated latent video branches before the frozen VAE into training. Frozen real score and trainable fake score receive the same noisy latent video, text condition and noise level. Their difference supplies the DMD update to G. Fake-score flow loss updates only fake-score parameters.

Fake-score flow target is epsilon minus sg(X), following FlowPredLoss in https://github.com/guandeh17/Self-Forcing/blob/main/utils/loss.py . The flow arrows and residual marks are schematic, not measured vectors or a new ODE/SDE solver.

The mouse storyboard is AI-generated illustrative artwork, not Self Forcing model output. Text, modules, tiles and arrows are native editable shapes. Storyboard frames and icons are separate replaceable raster pictures. Fonts: Comic Sans MS and Times New Roman, not embedded.
